city_center.name: Downtown Sacramento / Old Sacramento + the Central Valley farm belt
city_center.landmark: the California State Capitol; Old Sacramento's Gold Rush-era brick waterfront; the Sacramento River; the Central Valley, America's most productive farm region
city_center.notes: Sacramento is the self-styled 'Farm-to-Fork Capital of America', sitting at the heart of the Central Valley -- the most productive agricultural region in the US. Old Sacramento preserves Gold Rush-era brick buildings along the river. sources: en.wikipedia.org Sacramento, California; Sacramento Farm-to-Fork framing.

featured_frontier.photo_cue: cast-iron flapjack stack on a Gold Rush brick waterfront porch, Central Valley peaches and Delta corn, State Capitol dome, valley-oak and golden-grass light
featured_frontier.signature_ingredient: Central Valley stone fruit (peaches, nectarines, cherries; summer) + Delta sweet corn + California citrus (winter); tomatoes

cultural_notes: Sacramento brands itself the 'Farm-to-Fork Capital of America', sitting in the Central Valley -- the most productive agricultural region in the US, supplying stone fruit, tomatoes, corn, and citrus (source: Sacramento Farm-to-Fork framing; farmtofork.com)
Old Sacramento preserves Gold Rush-era brick buildings along the Sacramento River, a signature waterfront (source: en.wikipedia.org Sacramento, California)

Sacramento has one of the largest Hmong communities in the US, alongside a large Latino community and historic Chinese presence -- a diverse food culture (source: general demographic framing, publicly documented)
Raley's (a Sacramento-founded chain), Safeway, and Bel Air are the metro grocers (source: chain regional footprint)

design_palette._provenance_note: Gold Rush brick red + Capitol white grounded in Sacramento's historic architecture. golden-grass tan + valley-oak green from the Central Valley terrain. peach-blush from the stone-fruit crop. hex values are perceptual approximations, not sampled -- flag for brand-fit review against fixed brand palette.
